requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 设计一个交互式计数与报警系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 加一，D3 减一，数码管显示当前值；当计数为偶数时 LED 亮，为奇数时 LED 灭；当计数达到 15 时蜂鸣器报警并锁定计数，直到长按 D3 复位。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: starting with alarmLocked=false,count=0; apply rising edge on io_0 repeatedly to reach count=15, with no io_1 edges until reaching 15
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_4 shows incremental count values ending at 15; io_3 becomes nonzero (alarm) and alarmLocked holds so further io_0 edges do not change io_4

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 设计一个交互式计数与报警系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 加一，D3 减一，数码管显示当前值；当计数为偶数时 LED 亮，为奇数时 LED 灭；当计数达到 15 时蜂鸣器报警并锁定计数，直到长按 D3 复位。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: with alarmLocked=false, apply rising edge on io_0 once from count=0 to count=1, then apply rising edge on io_0 once from count=1 to count=2
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_2 is false when count=1 and true when count=2 (LED on even, off odd); io_4 tracks 1 then 2

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 设计一个交互式计数与报警系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 加一，D3 减一，数码管显示当前值；当计数为偶数时 LED 亮，为奇数时 LED 灭；当计数达到 15 时蜂鸣器报警并锁定计数，直到长按 D3 复位。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: with alarmLocked=false,count=0, apply rising edge on io_1 once (count down rollover); then apply rising edge on io_1 again
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_4 becomes 15 after first down edge, then becomes 14 after second down edge; alarm remains off so io_3 stays 0

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 设计一个交互式计数与报警系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 加一，D3 减一，数码管显示当前值；当计数为偶数时 LED 亮，为奇数时 LED 灭；当计数达到 15 时蜂鸣器报警并锁定计数，直到长按 D3 复位。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: drive system to alarmLocked=true by counting up to 15; then apply a rising edge on io_1 to reset
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: after reset edge, alarmLocked clears, io_3 returns to 0, and io_4 resets to 0; LED follows even count so io_2 becomes true
